card.name: Inside newer brand drug names
card.fires_on: Early pieces of newly launched brand-name drugs, such as TECENTRIQ, ORENCIA, ONGENTYS, BIMZELX and ZYMFENTRA, when the name is split into parts. It fires partway through the name, before the rest of the name arrives.

modes.label: Brand names in capitals
modes.description: The first or middle piece of an uppercase brand name in a label's dosing or warnings text.

modes.label: Other drug names
modes.description: Partway through a generic drug name, less often than brand names.
modes.example: Clopidogrel or pras<<ug>>rel administered during KENGREAL infusion

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward the next piece of a rare brand name, away from common pieces like itt or att.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of an unusual brand drug name that is spelled out in pieces.
